summary.vi: Phân biệt cấm đoán (mustn't, can't, not allowed to) với không cần thiết (don't have to, don't need to, needn't).
summary.en: Distinguish prohibition (mustn't, can't, not allowed to) from lack of necessity (don't have to, don't need to, needn't).

when_to_use.vi: Khi muốn nói một hành động bị cấm, dùng mustn't, can't hoặc be not allowed to.
when_to_use.en: When you want to say an action is forbidden, use mustn't, can't, or be not allowed to.

when_to_use.vi: Khi muốn nói một hành động không bắt buộc, dùng don't have to, don't need to hoặc needn't.
when_to_use.en: When you want to say an action is not required, use don't have to, don't need to, or needn't.

when_to_use.vi: Khi phân biệt giữa bị cấm và không cần, chú ý mustn't khác hoàn toàn với don't have to.
when_to_use.en: When distinguishing between forbidden and not necessary, note that mustn't is completely different from don't have to.

examples.text: You mustn't use your phone during the exam.

annotation.vi: mustn't diễn tả hành động bị cấm.

translation.vi: Bạn không được dùng điện thoại trong giờ thi.
translation.en: You mustn't use your phone during the exam.

examples.text: You don't have to come early.

annotation.vi: don't have to diễn tả không bắt buộc, không phải cấm.
annotation.en: don't have to expresses lack of necessity, not prohibition.

translation.en: You don't have to come early.

examples.text: Visitors aren't allowed to enter this room.

annotation.vi: aren't allowed to diễn tả hành động bị cấm.
annotation.en: aren't allowed to expresses a forbidden action.

translation.vi: Khách không được phép vào phòng này.
translation.en: Visitors aren't allowed to enter this room.

common_mistakes.wrong: You mustn't bring anything if you don't want to.
common_mistakes.right: You don't have to bring anything if you don't want to.

reason.vi: Người học nhầm mustn't (cấm) với don't have to (không cần).
reason.en: Learners confuse mustn't (prohibition) with don't have to (lack of necessity).

quick_practice.q: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It's against the rules.

explain.vi: mustn't diễn tả hành động bị cấm; don't have to nghĩa là không cần.
explain.en: mustn't expresses prohibition; don't have to means lack of necessity.

quick_practice.q: You ___ pay now. You can pay later.

explain.vi: don't have to diễn tả không bắt buộc; mustn't nghĩa là bị cấm.
explain.en: don't have to expresses lack of necessity; mustn't means prohibition.

quick_practice.q: You ___ bring any food. We have plenty.

explain.vi: needn't theo sau là động từ nguyên thể không 'to'.
explain.en: needn't is followed by the base form of the verb without 'to'.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu nói về một việc bạn không cần phải làm, dùng don't have to, don't need to hoặc needn't.
prompt.en: Write a sentence about something you don't have to do, using don't have to, don't need to, or needn't.

sample.text: I don't have to work tomorrow.

corrections.issue: R5 example 'You needn't bring any food.' is correct but the mistake 'You needn't to pay now.' is listed as a common mistake; the correction is fine, but the lesson did not explicitly state that needn't takes the base form without 'to'.
corrections.fix: Added a quick-practice item and explanation that needn't is followed by the base verb without 'to'.

corrections.issue: R5 did not provide a clear formula or structured spans for the target structures.
corrections.fix: Added formula and negative formula with abstract slots and options, and provided spans for all examples.

corrections.issue: R5 included a guided practice item 'You mustn't use your phone during the exam.' as recognition, but the lesson lacked a clear contrast between prohibition and lack of necessity in the practice.
corrections.fix: Added quick-practice items that contrast mustn't and don't have to, and a personal production task focusing on lack of necessity.
